attributes.name: operationalStatus
attributes.description: The current operational status of the flight as changed by each milestone (e.g. INITIATED, AIRBORNE, LANDED, OFF-BLOCK).

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Whether the flight is the arriving or departing leg of the aircraft's turn-round (milestone 1).

attributes.name: regulated
attributes.description: Whether the flight has been issued a CTOT and its fields marked REGULATED, giving it priority over unregulated flights (milestone 2).

attributes.name: readinessDeadlineOffset
attributes.description: The flight is ready not later than 15 minutes after the planned EOBT (milestone 1).

attributes.name: eobt
attributes.description: The flight's Estimated Off-Block Time, used as the reference point for milestone triggers such as EOBT-3hr and EOBT-2hr (milestones 1,2,3,9,10).

attributes.name: tobt
attributes.description: The flight's Target Off-Block Time, provided and updated by the AO/GH and checked at every downstream milestone (milestones 2-13).

attributes.name: aobt
attributes.description: The flight's Actual Off-Block Time, recorded when the aircraft pushes back (milestone 15).

attributes.name: etot
attributes.description: The flight's Estimated Take-Off Time, updated at flight plan activation and EOBT-2hr (milestones 1,2).

attributes.name: ttot
attributes.description: The flight's Target/Calculated Take-Off Time, computed from EIBT+MTTT+EXOT or TOBT+EXOT and reported to Network Operations when it changes beyond tolerance (milestones 2-10,15).

attributes.name: ctot
attributes.description: The flight's Calculated Take-Off Time issued by Network Operations at EOBT-2hr for regulated flights (milestones 2,13).

attributes.name: eldt
attributes.description: The flight's Estimated Landing Time, updated progressively from flight plan activation through final approach (milestones 1-6).

attributes.name: aldt
attributes.description: The flight's Actual Landing Time, recorded on touchdown (milestone 6).

attributes.name: eibt
attributes.description: The flight's Estimated In-Block Time, computed from ELDT or ALDT plus taxi-in time (milestones 1,2,3,4,6,7).

attributes.name: aibt
attributes.description: The flight's Actual In-Block Time, recorded on arrival in-blocks (milestones 7,8).

attributes.name: atot
attributes.description: The flight's Actual Take-Off Time, recorded from an outstation or at the home airport (milestones 3,16).

attributes.name: exot
attributes.description: The flight's Estimated Taxi-Out Time calculated by the ATC system, used in TTOT calculation (milestones 2,3,9,15).

attributes.name: exit
attributes.description: The flight's estimated taxi-in time used with ELDT or ALDT to compute EIBT (milestones 4,6).

attributes.name: mttt
attributes.description: The flight's minimum turn-round time used with EIBT to calculate TTOT (milestones 2,3).

attributes.name: ettt
attributes.description: The flight's estimated turn-round time on which TOBT is calculated after ground handling starts (milestone 8).

attributes.name: acgt
attributes.description: The flight's Actual Commence of Ground Handling Time, equal to AIBT for a normal turn-round (milestones 7,8).

attributes.name: tsat
attributes.description: The flight's Target Start-Up Approval Time issued by ATC, stabilising it in the pre-departure sequence (milestones 9-14).

attributes.name: asbt
attributes.description: The flight's Actual Start Boarding Time, recorded when boarding physically starts (milestone 11).

attributes.name: ardt
attributes.description: The flight's Actual Ready Time, recorded when the aircraft is ready to taxi (milestone 12).

attributes.name: asrt
attributes.description: The flight's Actual Start-up Request Time, recorded when the pilot requests start-up (milestone 13).

attributes.name: asat
attributes.description: The flight's Actual Start-up Approval Time, recorded when start-up approval is received (milestone 14).

attributes.name: arrivingFlight
attributes.description: The arriving flight of the aircraft turn-round (milestone 1).

attributes.name: departingFlight
attributes.description: The related departing flight of the aircraft turn-round, for which TOBT/TTOT are calculated from the turn-round period (milestones 1,6,7,8).

attributes.name: turnRoundType
attributes.description: Whether the turn-round is a normal turn-round (ACGT commences at AIBT) or a first-of-day/long-term-parked turn-round with a separately recorded ACGT (milestone 8).

attributes.name: aircraftType
attributes.description: The type of aircraft, which may be updated from the ATC Flight Plan (milestone 1).

attributes.name: registration
attributes.description: The aircraft registration, provided by the Aircraft Operator before the first E-DPI message (milestone 1).

attributes.name: repetitive
attributes.description: Whether the flight plan is a repetitive flight plan (RFPL) covering daily or weekly flights (milestone 1).

attributes.name: scheduledOffBlockTime
attributes.description: The Scheduled Off-Block Time fed to Network Operations before the first E-DPI message (milestone 1).

attributes.name: firstDestination
attributes.description: The first destination aerodrome data fed to Network Operations before the first E-DPI message (milestone 1).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The time value of this time quantity.

attributes.name: originator
attributes.description: The party or system that provided or last updated this value (e.g. AO/GH, ATC, Network Operations, ACARS, radar).

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The stated accuracy or locally agreed tolerance of this time value, where the document specifies one.

attributes.name: recordedAt
attributes.description: The time at which this value was appended to the flight's history; earlier values are kept, not overwritten, so the turn-round can be analysed afterwards.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: ATOT is available with an accuracy of +/- 1 minute (milestones 3,16).

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: ALDT is available with an accuracy of +/- 1 minute (milestone 6).

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: AIBT is available with an accuracy of +/- 1 minute (milestone 7).

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: ACGT is available with an accuracy of +/- 1 minute (milestone 8).

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: ASBT is available with an accuracy of +/- 1 minute (milestone 11).

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: ARDT is directly available with an accuracy of +/- 1 minute (milestone 12).

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: ASRT is available with an accuracy of +/- 1 minute (milestone 13).

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: ASAT is available with an accuracy of +/- 1 minute (milestone 14).

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: AOBT is available with an accuracy of +/- 1 minute (milestone 15).

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: TOBT accuracy at final confirmation is agreed locally (milestone 9).

attributes.name: updateCount
attributes.description: The number of times TOBT has been updated since TSAT was issued, checked against a locally defined tolerance (milestone 10).

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: TSAT accuracy is agreed locally (milestone 10).

attributes.name: toleranceThreshold
attributes.description: The TTOT tolerance (e.g. 5 minutes at take off from outstation) that must be exceeded before Network Operations is informed of an updated TTOT (milestones 3-9,15).

attributes.name: earliestTriggerOffset
attributes.description: The process is first triggered at the earliest EOBT-3 hr (milestone 1).

attributes.name: triggerOffset
attributes.description: This check is triggered by a time stamp at EOBT-2 hr (milestone 2).

attributes.name: issuanceOffset
attributes.description: ATC issues TSAT t-minutes before EOBT, where t is a locally agreed parameter (milestone 10).

attributes.name: updateCountThreshold
attributes.description: The locally defined tolerance on the number of TOBT updates allowed after TSAT has been issued before local procedure applies (milestone 10).

attributes.name: confirmationOffset
attributes.description: The final TOBT is provided t minutes before EOBT, where t is a locally agreed parameter (milestone 9).

attributes.name: triggerOffset
attributes.description: The boarding status check is triggered a locally defined number of minutes before TOBT, e.g. corresponding to aircraft type (milestone 11).

attributes.name: toleranceOffset
attributes.description: At TOBT plus a locally agreed tolerance, the AO/GH are informed that no ready status has been received (milestone 12).

attributes.name: toleranceWindow
attributes.description: The locally agreed TSAT tolerance window within which start-up must be requested before an alert is raised (milestone 13).

attributes.name: toleranceOffset
attributes.description: If start-up approval is not granted by TSAT plus a locally agreed tolerance, all relevant partners are informed and the flight is re-sequenced (milestone 14).

attributes.name: dpiType
attributes.description: The type of DPI message sent, determined by the triggering milestone (E-DPI, T-DPI, T-DPI-t, T-DPI-s, A-DPI).
